package.name: adhere_keyboard_input
package.description: Decoupled FSM/teleop terminal + Xbox gamepad bridge for the KAMR-MPPI ROV (CLAUDE.md Phase 3.2): fsm_console_node (master state-switcher), state_cmd_console_node (DEPTH_HOLD/PID_HOLD setpoint terminal), and xbox_teleop_node (joy -> TeleopCommand/FsmCommand bridge). Zero dependency on MuJoCo/CUDA/ros2_control, so it deploys standalone on a remote Upper-Computer (GCS) laptop.
